context: A police officer briefs on coordination
purpose: Teach: 可視/リテラシー/言葉遣い/学ぼ/決行/見立て/置き換える/近接

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 防犯活動、可視化、皆で取り組みましょう。
lines.en: Let's make crime prevention visible and work on it together.
lines.style: Measured, official opening. Clear diction. Steady eye contact. A slight pause after the first phrase—giving weight to the pivot toward collaboration, not command.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員のリテラシー教育、警察と連動させます。
lines.en: Understood. We'll coordinate our staff literacy training with the police.
lines.style: Brisk, businesslike. A touch lighter than the officer—not matching formality exactly, but meeting him halfway. Forward momentum. Nodding tone.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 住民への言葉遣い、丁寧に。
lines.en: When you're speaking with residents, please keep your language careful and respectful.
lines.style: Gentle instruction, not scolding. Warm undercurrent. The tone of someone who's coaching, not correcting. Slight breath before the key word.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察からも、学ぼうと、研修参加しています。
lines.en: Yes. We're showing up to the police training because we want to learn from you.
lines.style: Earnest. A small emphasis on 'want'—genuine commitment, not rote compliance. Slightly slower pace. The cadence of someone stating something he means.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 合同訓練、来週、決行します。
lines.en: The joint drill will happen next week. We'll execute it.
lines.style: Direct and certain. No hedge. Quick, clipped rhythm. The voice of someone setting a date in stone. Professional closure on each phrase.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。地域の見立て、両社で共有します。
lines.en: Understood. We'll share our local observations with both your team and ours.
lines.style: Practical and clear. Slightly eager—showing he's already thinking through the details. Even tempo. The efficiency of someone who's already mapping it out.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 古い通信機器、警察と協調、置き換える予定です。
lines.en: The older communication equipment will be replaced through coordination with the police.
lines.style: Factual, forward-looking. A touch of relief underneath—a problem being solved. Even delivery. No apology, no oversell. Just statement of action.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 駅近接の交番、連絡密にします。
lines.en: We'll keep close contact with the station koban nearby.
lines.style: Confident and grounded. Slight warmth—the comfort of proximity and reliable connection. Quick, assured. The certainty of someone who's already planning the schedule.
